buffer_flush_throughput_rps.note: PUBLISH rows per second during replay after OUTAGE: END

recovery_time_s.note: OUTAGE: END to BUFFER: total=0 (fallback: last replay PUBLISH)

end_to_end_latency_ms.note: server_received_ms minus original telemetry ts (NTP-synced clocks); measured in the separate no-outage live run (cloud/benchmark/metrics_live.json)

message_delivery_ratio_pct.note: local generated rows whose original ts appears in ThingsBoard ph telemetry

alarm_activation_delay_ms.note: edge alarm transition to matching ThingsBoard alarm creation; measured in the separate no-outage live run (cloud/benchmark/metrics_live.json)

locally_synced_pct.note: edge PUBACK-confirmed rows / generated rows (no broker required)

data_loss.note: generated rows absent from ThingsBoard after full sync

notes: Delivery ratio, buffer throughput, recovery time and data loss are from the outage run (cloud/benchmark/metrics_outage.json; 32 s outage, 96 replayed rows).
End-to-end latency and alarm activation delay are from a separate 177 s no-outage live run (cloud/benchmark/metrics_live.json; 530 generated, 528 confirmed rows).
The outage-run latency (n=709, mean 270767.5 ms) includes time spent in the buffer and is reported separately in the manuscript as a resilience bound, not as live latency.
Tenant credentials were supplied through the environment; JWT expired after the first run and was refreshed before the second.
